definitions.explanation: A public gathering or march to express political or social opposition or support for a cause.

definitions.gloss: demo; demonstration (of a product or skill)
definitions.explanation: A practical display or preview showing how something works.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}たちがデモを{行|おこな}った。
{反戦|はんせん}デモに{何千人|なんぜんにん}もの{人|ひと}が{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: Thousands of people participated in the anti-war demonstration.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいソフトウェアのデモを{見|み}せてもらった。
examples.english: I was shown a demo of the new software.

notes:
Abbreviation of デモンストレーション (demonstration). Both meanings are common.

SENSE 1 (PROTEST) COLLOCATIONS:
- デモを{行|おこな}う: to hold a demonstration
- デモに{参加|さんか}する: to participate in a demonstration
- デモ{行進|こうしん}: demonstration march
- {反戦|はんせん}デモ: anti-war protest

SENSE 2 (DEMO) COLLOCATIONS:
- デモを{見|み}せる: to show a demo
- デモ{版|ばん}: demo version
- デモ{機|き}: demo unit/machine
